narration_text: His best friend would have noticed the stone he was holding wasn't a [Stone of Regression] immediately. Yoonhwan tightly held onto the stone. He felt the cold, rough edges. It was something he could only feel in this world.

narration_text: Then his body disappeared off to the clouds and Jaehwan stopped as he opened the gate to the 99th floor. He used his right hand to wipe off his face.
